metadata.description: claude-autoswitch: picks the cheapest Claude model that can handle each prompt. The autoswitch-inline plugin switches each turn's model inline.

plugins.name: autoswitch-inline
plugins.description: Picks each turn's model inside Claude Code (no stop, no wait) and shows a budget-mode band above the prompt. Needs claude-autoswitch installed (./install.sh) and `autoswitch speed inline`.
